text:
alana: Heads-up — Solaris Labs (acct SL-209) flagged at 67 days overdue on INV-2026-512 ($84,300). CFO emailed asking to place $40k into an escrow account while they audit a disputed analytics spike, and to pay the remaining $44,300 over 3 monthly installments. cc @bryan @tess

bryan: do we have a precedent for escrow arrangements? any legal constraints?

tess: Legal/collections note: we don't typically use escrow for receivables. we can offer a conditional hold where disputed amount is segregated off-ledger pending Ops verification, but funds need to clear before we mark settled. require signed escrow/hold agreement and clear dispute scope.

alana: customer claims a 50k anomalous run; they propose putting 40k in escrow now and we continue service if escrow confirmed. they also volunteered to pay $14,300 immediately toward the non-disputed portion. cs-bot: uploaded customer acceptance screenshot to #customer-docs.

omkar: Finance here — conservative approach: OK to accept an escrow deposit if it's held by a mutually agreed custodian (law firm trust or payments partner) and funds are irrevocable for the term. require: 1) signed escrow agreement, 2) proof of funds (txn id) for escrow deposit, 3) payment of $14,300 upfront within 5 business days, 4) PA for the installment schedule on remaining $44,300.

maria: Billing: can we create invoice split lines and mark escrowed amount as "segregated pending dispute" in the ledger? need to ensure AR aging logic doesn't double count.

billing-bot: Created provisional invoice revision INV-2026-512.rev1. Line items split: Disputed (escrow) $40,000; Immediate payment $14,300; Remaining scheduled $29, (placeholder) — please confirm amounts. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2026-512/rev1 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Placed temporary hold on aggressive collections for SL-209 while escrow docs and PA pending. Reminder scheduled in 8 days. Note: hold does not waive rights; automatic escalation resumes if conditions unmet.

bryan: small correction — remaining principal after $14,300 and $40k escrow should be $29, , math looks off. Alana, can you confirm numbers?

alana: sorry typo — corrected schedule: total $84,300 => escrow $40,000, upfront payment $14,300, balance to amortize $30,000 over 3 months ($10k/mo). I'll update invoice.

tess: Legal ok with escrow model if: escrow custodian agreed, scope of dispute and release conditions explicit, Redwood retains right to apply escrow to outstanding balance if dispute resolved in our favor, and timeline for Ops verification is defined (30 days). Include 7-day cure window for missed installment.

omkar: Omkar approves conditional terms: finance will accept escrow deposit and treat account as in-good-standing once funds clear into custodian control and upfront $14,300 posts. final waiver of late fees limited to escrow term and subject to Omkar sign-off after seeing txn ids and signed docs.

maria: Billing will mark $40k as "held — escrow" and set autopay schedule for the $30k amortization once PA received. need CS to upload the escrow custodian details and signed agreement to #customer-docs.

cs-bot: Customer provided payment custodian info (AcmeTrust) and sent a signed hold agreement screenshot to #customer-docs. Quote: "We'll push the escrow txn today and email wire confirmation."

billing-bot: Updated invoice revision INV-2026-512.rev2 with corrected line items: escrow $40,000, upfront $14,300 (posted as due), amortization $30,000. Link: https://billing.internal/redwood/invoices/INV-2026-512/rev2 :white_check_mark:

collections-bot: Reminder: if upfront $14,300 does not post within 5 business days, hold will be removed and standard collections resumed. Automated reminder scheduled in 5 days.

bryan: once escrow txn id + upfront payment post, billing/finance to apply payments and clear delinquency flag. Also recommend adding a note to the account: "Escrow arrangement in place — see INV-2026-512.rev2" for future audits.

omkar: I'll sign off on late fee waiver conditional on funds clearing. Omkar to approve after seeing escrow confirmation and upfront txn id.

alana: I'll send the formal escrow instruction and PA to their CFO now with 5-business-day window for the upfront. If we don't get escrow confirmation + $14,300 by next Tue, we'll lift hold and resume escalation. Thanks all. :handshake:
